verdict.rationale: Qodo docs explicitly state you can "Deploy Qodo entirely within your own infrastructure" (qodo-docs-16), and self-hosted VCS integration (e.g., Bitbucket Data Center) is documented (qodo-docs-17), indicating on-prem deployment support. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of a full self-hosted deployment (e.g., Docker/K8s install guide details, air-gapped operation specifics) beyond the single doc line.
